verdict.rationale: There is no explicit recurring-job or scheduling feature in the evidence. The closest support is indirect: Instinct proactively follows up on dropped threads and nudges users (instinct-docs-3, instinct-comm-17), and one reviewer handed it ongoing podcast-booking follow-ups that it handled continuously, pinging him only when needed (instinct-comm-11). These amount to standing delegated work rather than user-defined schedules. Missing for 10: an explicit way to set up recurring or cron-style tasks, controls for schedule frequency and timing, documentation of how scheduled workflows are managed, and hands-on confirmation of recurring execution.
